text: APPROVE. `Lex` is now a one-line delegate and the extracted methods preserve the original control flow exactly (comment skipping, raw strings, verbatim `""` handling, escapes, unterminated literals, the `is '$' or '@'` pattern). I only read the diff; I did not build it or run the analyzer.
